armySpecialRules.name: Bloodlines
armySpecialRules.description:
Most Vampires belong to a certain Bloodline, such as
von Carstein, Necrach, Lahmian, Blood Dragon or
Strigoi. Characters belonging to one Bloodline may not
join units belonging to another Bloodline, nor may two
characters from different Bloodlines join the same unit.

armySpecialRules.name: The Generals Of Undeath
armySpecialRules.description:
If your army contains any Undead units, you must
include at least one character that is a Wizard that uses
the Lore of Necromancy.
Slain General
At the end of the phase in which the General is
removed as a casualty, and at the start of every friendly
turn thereafter, all friendly Undead units (excluding
mounts) on the battlefield must take a Leadership test.
If the test is failed, the unit immediately suffers a
number of Wounds equal to the amount by which it
failed the Leadership test, with no saves of any kind
allowed. These Wounds are distributed as if from a
shooting attack.
If, at the start of any of your turns following the death
of the General, there is one or more friendly Wizard
Characters on the table who know spells from the Lore
of Necromancy, no unit in the army needs to take this
Leadership test while at least one of them remain.
Battle Standards
In addition to the normal rules for the army battle
standard, units of Undead within 12" of their battle
standard suffer D3 Wounds less than they normally
would due to the Unstable special rule, or following the
death of the army's General.
Characters and Units
Characters who are not Undead may join Undead units
despite not being Unstable themselves. Mounted
Characters ignore the Undead special rule of the
mount. If an Undead unit would get destroyed as a
result of Unstable, any remaining character(s) will need
to take a Break test as normal the same phase, using the
Leadership modifier that they lost the combat by.

armySpecialRules.name: Death Shriek
armySpecialRules.description:
A Death Shriek is a special attack that can be used
against a single unit in the Shooting phase, even if the
model has marched, charged, or the target is engaged in
close combat. This attack has a range of 8" and needs
line of sight to its target. If the model is engaged in
combat, its Death Shriek may target a unit in base
contact.
To resolve a Death Shriek, roll 2D6+3. For each point
by which the result exceeds the target unit's
Leadership, the target unit suffers 1 Wound which
Ignores Armour Saves. Death Shriek is a non-physical
Magical Attack and Wounds suffered from it are
distributed as if from shooting.

armySpecialRules.name: Master Of The Dead
armySpecialRules.description:
A model with this special rule can use the Invocation of
Nehek spell from the Lore of Necromancy to increase
units of Skeleton Warriors and Skeleton Archers
beyond their starting size.

armySpecialRules.name: Spectral Steeds
armySpecialRules.description:
Mounted models with this special rule gain the
Ethereal special rule for the purposes of movement
only. They do not suffer the movement penalty for
being barded. Whilst a unit with this special rule is
joined by a character without the Spectral Steeds or
Ethereal special rules, it loses this special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: Undead
armySpecialRules.description:
All models with the Undead special rule have the
Animated Construct, Fear, and Unstable special rules.
However, they may make march moves if they are
within the Army General's Inspiring Presence range or
are joined by a character with the Lore of Necromancy.

armySpecialRules.name: Vampiric
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with the Vampiric special rule have the Fear
and Immunity (Psychology) special rules. In addition,
models suffer -1 To Wound rolls against them, unless
they are using Magical Attacks or Flaming Attacks.
However, Vampiric models treat all rivers as Deadly
Terrain unless they are mounted.

armySpecialRules.name: The Red Thirst
armySpecialRules.description:
Roll a D6 at the end of each Close Combat phase in
which one or more models was slain by a Vampire with
this special rule. On a 5+, the Vampire recovers a single
Wound, up to their starting value (excluding additional
Wounds from mounts). This does not work against
Animated Constructs, Daemons, Forest Spirits or
Vampires.

magicItems.name: Frostblade
magicItems.description:
The wielder gains the Ice Attacks and Multiple Wounds
(D6) special rules.

magicItems.name: Skabscrath
magicItems.description:
The bearer has the Devastating Charge and Frenzy
special rules, and all close combat attacks made by the
bearer have the Flaming Attacks special rule. In
addition, the bearer of Skabscrath gains the Death
Shriek special rule.

magicItems.name: Slaking Blade
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon gains +1 Strength and
Attacks at the end of each close combat phase in which
they have inflicted at least 1 unsaved Wound (up to a
maximum of +3). This bonus lasts for the remainder of
the game.

magicItems.name: Dreadlance
magicItems.description:
Heavy lance. All attacks with this weapon
automatically Hit.

magicItems.name: Asp Bow
magicItems.description:
Bow. All shots from this item are resolved at Strength 4
with the Poisoned Attacks and Sniper special rules.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Vampire
s found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Slitter
magicItems.description:
Additional hand weapon. This adds one special attack
after the wielder has made their normal attacks. Roll a
D3; if the result is higher than the remaining number of
Wounds of the target, the target is instantly slain with
no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Keening Bone
magicItems.description:
Strigoi only. Throwing weapon. All shots with this
weapon automatically Hit. Characters may take this
item despite not normally being allowed to take
throwing weapons.

magicItems.name: Reaper Of Sorrows
magicItems.description:
Cairn Wraith only. Great weapon. All attacks with this
weapon automatically Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Kings
magicItems.description:
Wight Kings only. This item makes the model's Killing
Blow special rule take effect on a 5+.

magicItems.name: The Balefire Spike
magicItems.description:
Heavy lance. This item gives the wielder the
Devastating Charge and Flaming Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: Shadow'S Edge
magicItems.description:
For every natural 6 rolled To Hit with this weapon, that
Attack has the Ignores Armour Saves and Multiple
Wounds (D3) special rules.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Night
magicItems.description:
Von Carstein model on foot only. Heavy armour. This
item causes any missile attacks targeted at the wearer
or any unit they are with to suffer -1 To Hit.
magicItems.restriction: Von Carstein model on foot only.

magicItems.name: The Flayed Hauberk
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. Heavy armour. This item gives the
wearer a 2+ armour save that cannot be improved by
any means.

magicItems.name: Helm Of Commandment
magicItems.description:
This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save. If the
wearer is not engaged in close combat at the start of the
Close Combat phase, one friendly Undead unit
(including mounts) within 12" may use the wearer's
unmodified Weapon Skill instead of their own that
round.

magicItems.name: The Scabbing Plate
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. The wearer of this armour automatically
restores 1 Wound lost during the battle at the end of
each round of close combat in which it has inflicted
one or more unsaved Wounds.

magicItems.name: The Accursed Armour
magicItems.description:
Heavy armour. This item gives the wearer +1
Toughness, but makes them suffer -1 Weapon Skill and
Initiative.

magicItems.name: The Armour Of Blood
magicItems.description:
Blood Dragon only. Heavy armour. This item allows
the wielder to automatically regain Wounds through the
Red Thirst.

magicItems.name: The Red Casket
magicItems.description:
Blood Dragon only. Heavy armour. The wearer of this
armour gains the Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: Wailing Helm
magicItems.description:
This item gives the wearer a 6+ armour save and the
Terror special rule.

magicItems.name: The Cadaverous Cuirass
magicItems.description:
Vampires only. Heavy armour. This item gives the
wearer the Immunity (Killing Blow) special rule.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Bone
magicItems.description:
Medium armour. When the wearer fails their first
armour save (or if they are wounded by an attack which
ignores armour saves), the Armour of Bone crumbles to
dust and is destroyed, but the Wound is ignored. This
armour may be taken by Necromancers despite them
normally not being allowed to take armour.

magicItems.name: The Cursed Shield Of Mousillon
magicItems.description:
Shield. This item causes one enemy model in base
contact of your choice to lose 1 Attack. In addition, the
bearer gains the Hatred (Bretonnia) special rule, and all
models in Warhammer: Bretonnia have the Hatred
special rule against the bearer.

magicItems.name: Nightshroud
magicItems.description:
Infantry or Cavalry only. Enemy models in base
contact with the wearer lose all Strength bonuses
conferred from normal and magical weapons, and are
subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: Talisman Of The Nadir
magicItems.description:
All friendly units within 12" of the bearer of this item
gain the Magic Resistance (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: The Gem Of Blood
magicItems.description:
Vampires only. One use only. The Gem of Blood
activates when the bearer suffers their first Wound in
close combat (before saves). Roll a D6; on a roll of a 1
the wearer suffers the Wound as normal, and an
additional Wound with no saves allowed. On a 2+ the
Wound is saved, and is rebounded onto the model that
caused it with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Splintervane Broach
magicItems.description:
Strigoi only. All enemy Wizards within 18" of the
bearer of this item suffer -1 to casting penalty.

magicItems.name: Wristbands Of Black Gold
magicItems.description:
The Wristbands of Black Gold gives the wearer a
Magical Ward (3+) against all missile attacks.

magicItems.name: Chiropteran Cloak
magicItems.description:
Von Carstein only. If a model attacking the wearer of
this item rolls a natural 1 To Hit in close combat, they
suffer a Strength 4 Hit.

magicItems.name: Cloak Of The Waxing Moon
magicItems.description:
Cairn Wraith only. The wearer of this item can only be
Hit on To Hit rolls of natural 6's.

magicItems.name: The Dermal Robe
magicItems.description:
Relic. The wearer gains a +1 casting and dispel bonus.
In addition, they gain +1 to their channelling rolls.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Raukhamon
magicItems.description:
Necrarch only. Staff. Bound Spell. This staff contains
the Hellish Vigour spell from the Lore of Necromancy.
Roll a D6 each time the Staff is used. On a roll of 1, the
Staff is temporarily exhausted and cannot cast this
bound spell for the rest of the battle. In addition, all
enemy units within 6" of the Staff`s bearer suffer a -1
penalty on their rolls To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: Sceptre De Noirot
magicItems.description:
Staff. The bearer of this item may re-roll one dice of
their choice when determining the number of Zombies
or Skeletons raised with the Invocation of Nehek and
Raise Dead spells from the Lore of Necromancy.

magicItems.name: Book Of Arkhan
magicItems.description:
Relic. Bound Spell. This item casts the Vanhel's Danse
Macabre spell from the Lore of Necromancy.

magicItems.name: Carrion Wand
magicItems.description:
Strigoi only. Staff. The wielder counts their Wizard
level as being 1 higher than normal.

magicItems.name: The Cursed Book
magicItems.description:
Relic. At the beginning of the bearer's Magic phase, the
bearer may choose to sacrifice one power dice from the
pool. If they do so, roll a D6 on the following chart.
Assuming there is a viable target for the indicated spell,
that spell is automatically cast at its minimum casting
value, requiring no power dice. A dispel attempt can be
made as normal.
D6 Spell Cast
1 Melkoth's Mystifying Miasma (Lore of
Shadow)
2 The Enfeebling Foe (Lore of Shadow)
3 The Withering (Lore of Shadow)
4 Portent of Doom (Lore of Heavens)
5 Doom and Darkness (Lore of Death)
6 Soulblight (Lore of Death)

magicItems.name: Rod Of Flaming Death
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell. Staff. This item casts the Fulminating
Flame Cage spell from the Lore of Fire.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Damnation
magicItems.description:
Staff. Bound Spell (Level 2, cast on 8+). If cast
successfully, this item casts an augment spell. All
Undead models (including mounts) in friendly units
within 6" of the bearer gain +1 Attack until the start of
the bearer's next Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Black Periapt
magicItems.description:
Relic. The Black Periapt allows the bearer to save up to
two of his army's unused power dice or dispel dice at
the end of any Magic phase, and then add them to his
side's power or dispel dice pool at the start of the next
Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Blasphemous Tome
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer of this item gains a +2 casting bonus
when using the Lore of Necromancy. However, if they
Miscast, they must roll on additional D6 on the Miscast
table and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: Wychlight Lantern
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. This item can be used during any
of your Magic phases. Once used, it allows the bearer
to cast one of their spells automatically without using
any power dice, at its minimum casting value.

magicItems.name: Amulet Of Screams
magicItems.description:
Lahmian only. Relic. Roll a D6 every time an enemy
Wizard within 18" successfully casts a spell. On a 1,
that Wizard suffer 1 Wound which Ignores Armour
saves.

magicItems.name: Crimson Gem Of Lahmia
magicItems.description:
Lahmian only. Once per magic phase, while casting
spells, the bearer of the Crimson Gem of Lahmia can
choose to take a Toughness test. If passed, they may re-
roll a single power dice of their choice. If failed, they
suffer a Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Midnight Tome
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. This item can be used when the
wearer successfully casts a spell with a casting value of
10 or less. When used, the opponent cannot attempt to
dispel it.

magicItems.name: Morbheg'S Claw
magicItems.description:
Von Carstein only. Relic. The wearer of this item gains
+2 to cast spells if they have not moved that turn or are
not engaged in close combat.

magicItems.name: Stave Of Suffering
magicItems.description:
Staff. The bearer of this item gains a +1 casting bonus
for each spell that has successfully inflicted one or
more unsaved Wounds the same Magic Phase. This
bonus is cumulative.

magicItems.name: Midnight Amulet
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item can be used in any of your
Magic phases. Pick one enemy unit within 12"; that
unit suffers D6 Strength 4 Hits multiplied by the
number of the current game turn.

magicItems.name: The Casket Of Ages
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell (Level 1, cast on 6+). The Casket of Ages
contains a direct damage spell that targets one enemy
model in base contact. The target model suffers one
Wound which Ignores Armour Saves. If the Wound is
not saved, the victim must pass a Toughness test or
suffer an additional Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Talon Of Death
magicItems.description:
All enemy models in base contact with the bearer must
pass a Toughness test or suffer a Wound which Ignores
Armour saves at the start of each round of combat.

magicItems.name: Dreadbolt Ring
magicItems.description:
For each unsaved Wound the bearer of this item inflicts
in close combat, one enemy unit in base contact suffer
D3 Strength 3 Attacks with the Flaming Attacks special
rule after they have resolved their normal attacks.

magicItems.name: Breath Of The Void Maw
magicItems.description:
Necrarch only. One use only. This item can be used at
the start of any Magic phase. Once used, pick one
enemy unit within 6" that is not engaged in close
combat. Roll a D6; on a 2+ the target unit suffer a
number of Strength 5 Hits equal to the roll.

magicItems.name: Fragment Of The Keep
magicItems.description:
Blood Dragon only. The bearer gains the Always
Strikes First special rule.

magicItems.name: The Grim Garland
magicItems.description:
Strigoi only. Enemy units in base contact with the
bearer must roll 3D6 for their Leadership tests and
discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: Lightshard Of The Harvest Moon
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item can be used at the start of any
close combat phase. The bearer and any unit they are
with may re-roll failed rolls To Hit for the duration of
the turn.

magicItems.name: Pendant Of The Fell Wind
magicItems.description:
The character and any unit they are with gain +1
Movement.

magicItems.name: The Saccharine Goblet
magicItems.description:
Vampire only. This item can be used at the start of any
round of close combat. When used, the bearer gains +1
To Hit and To Wound. However, for each of their
Attacks that does not inflict an unsaved Wound, they
must pass a Toughness test or suffer one Wound with
no saves allowed at the end of the combat (before
Break tests are taken).

magicItems.name: Sigil Of The Sanguine Throne
magicItems.description:
Von Carstein only. The bearer and any friendly
Vampire unit within 12" may re-roll one of their charge
distance dice.

magicItems.name: The Furious Crown
magicItems.description:
In any turn in which the bearer of this item makes a
successful charge, they gain +1 Attack for every enemy
model in base contact, up to a maximum of +3.

magicItems.name: Grave-Sand Shard
magicItems.description:
Blood Dragon only. One use only. This item can be
used in any of your Magic phases. Once used, it
automatically restores Wounds to any unit they are with
following the rules for Invocation of Nehek from the
Lore of Necromancy.

magicItems.name: Medal Of Madness
magicItems.description:
Strigoi only. The bearer gains the Inspiring Presence
(6) special rule.

magicItems.name: Soulfire Ring
magicItems.description:
Cairn Wraith only. For every unsaved Wound caused in
close combat by the bearer, they and/or their unit
regain 1 Wound, just like a summoning spell.

magicItems.name: Blood River Chalice
magicItems.description:
Vampire only. One use only. This item can be used at
the start of the controlling player's turn. The model
immediately recovers all lost Wounds (ignoring any
additional Wounds from mounts) up to their starting
value.

magicItems.name: Brazier Of Nagashizzar
magicItems.description:
Cairn Wraith only. The bearer and any unit they join
may re-roll failed charge and pursuit distances.

magicItems.name: Mirror Of Echoing Failures
magicItems.description:
Any Wizard within 18" of the bearer that fails a
spellcasting attempt (not including dispels) suffers one
Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: Nathmar'S Skull
magicItems.description:
Master Necromancer or Necromancer only. All friendly
units of Skeletons and Zombies within 12" of the
bearer may March despite being Undead.

magicItems.name: Ruby Vial
magicItems.description:
Vampire only. One use only. This item can be used at
the start of any of your turns. Until the start of your
next turn, all enemy units within 18" of the bearer
suffer -1 to their Movement.

magicItems.name: Signet Of The First Court
magicItems.description:
Strigoi only. The bearer of this item gains the Killing
Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: The Bilious Decanter
magicItems.description:
Ghoul or Strigoi only. One use only. This item can be
used at the start of any close combat phase. The bearer
gains the Frenzy special rule and +1 Attack for the
remainder of the game. However, they will
automatically fail any Berserk Rage tests and must
always Pursue.

magicItems.name: Orb Of Enchantment
magicItems.description:
Lahmian only. One enemy model in base contact
(chosen by the bearer) must take a Leadership test at
the start of each round of close combat. If failed, they
may not attack this turn.

magicItems.name: Talisman Of The Lycni
magicItems.description:
Vampire only. Model on foot only. The bearer of this
item gains +4 to their Movement value and the
Swiftstride special rule. In addition, they may join units
of Dire Wolves.

magicItems.name: Heart Of The Giant Feast
magicItems.description:
Vampire only. One use only. This item can be used at
the start of any close combat phase. The bearer can re-
roll failed To Wound rolls for the duration of the turn.

magicItems.name: Shard Of Night
magicItems.description:
Vampire only. One use only. This item may be used at
the start of any round of Close Combat. When it is, the
bearer suffers 1 Wound with no saves allowed. In
exchange, they gain +2 Strength for the duration of this
round of close combat.

magicItems.name: The Drakenhof Banner
magicItems.description:
Von Carstein or Wight only. May only be taken if your
army includes a von Carstein Vampire Character. All
Undead models (excluding mounts) in the unit carrying
this standard gain the Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: The Flag Of Blood Keep
magicItems.description:
Blood Knights only. May only be taken if your army
includes a Blood Dragon Vampire Character. The unit
carrying this standard gains a Magical Ward (4+)
against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Barrows
magicItems.description:
All Wights in the same unit as this standard receive +1
To Hit in close combat. This does not apply to mounts.

magicItems.name: Hell Banner
magicItems.description:
All enemy units with Line of Sight to this standard
suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership. This standard
has no effect on models with Immunity (Psychology).

magicItems.name: Cursed Pennant Of Mousillon
magicItems.description:
Blood Dragon, Skeletons, Wights or Blood Knights
only. May only be taken if your army includes a Blood
Dragon Vampire Character. Any enemy unit that is in
base contact with the unit carrying this standard must
re-roll 6's when rolling To Hit, To Wound and when
taking armour saves.
magicItems.restriction:
Blood Dragon, Skeletons, Wights or Blood Knights
only.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Doom
magicItems.description:
All Undead models (excluding mounts) in the unit
carrying this standard gains the Regeneration (5+)
special rule against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Dead Legion
magicItems.description:
All Undead models (including mounts) in the unit
carrying this standard counts as having twice their
actual Unit Strength in close combat.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Hellfire
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell. This banner contains the Flaming Sword
of Rhuin spell from the Lore of Fire. It can only be cast
on the unit carrying this standard.

magicItems.name: The Flayed Pennant
magicItems.description:
Strigoi or Ghoul only. The unit carrying this standard
gains the Frenzy special rule.

magicItems.name: Infernal Standard
magicItems.description:
Wight King with Battle Standard only. The model
carrying this standard gains the Hold Your Ground (6)
special rule.
magicItems.restriction: Wight King with Battle Standard only.

magicItems.name: Royal Standard Of Strigos
magicItems.description:
May only be taken if your army includes a Strigoi
Vampire Character. Strigoi or Ghoul only. The unit
carrying this standard gains the Hatred special rule.
magicItems.restriction:
May only be taken if your army includes a Strigoi
Vampire Character. Strigoi or Ghoul only.

magicItems.name: The Screaming Banner
magicItems.description:
Enemy units on base contact with the unit carrying this
standard must pass a Leadership test at the start of each
close combat phase. If failed, they require 6's To Hit
for the duration of the phase.

magicItems.name: Icon Of Vengeance
magicItems.description:
Any Undead model (including mounts) in the unit
carrying this standard that is slain in close combat may
immediately make an additional Attack, even if they
have already attacked this turn.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Hellish Vigour
magicItems.description:
Undead only. May only be taken if your army includes
a Necrarch Vampire Character. The unit carrying this
standard may March despite being Animated
Constructs.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Endless Nightmare
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard counts as having one
more rank than normal for the purpose of combat
resolution.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Everlasting Death
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard suffers one fewer
Wound than they normally would due to the Unstable
special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Red Fury
vampiric_powers.description:
Blood Dragon or Strigoi only. For each unsaved Wound
caused by the model in close combat, it can
immediately make an additional Attack (to a maximum
of +3 Attacks). These additional Attacks do not benefit
from Red Fury.

vampiric_powers.name: Unholy Regeneration
vampiric_powers.description:
Necrarch or Strigoi only. The model gains the
Regeneration (4+) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Curse Of The Revenant
vampiric_powers.description:
Necrarch or Strigoi only. The model has a 3+
invulnerable save when they have a single Wound
remaining (if the model suffers multiple Wounds in a
single turn, it is reduced to 1 Wound and may then
attempt to take this invulnerable save).

vampiric_powers.name: Fear Incarnate
vampiric_powers.description:
All enemy units in base contact with the model must
pass a Leadership test at the start of each round of close
combat or suffer -1 To Hit this round.

vampiric_powers.name: Flying Horror
vampiric_powers.description:
Model on foot only. Thе model gains the Fly (10)
special rule and may join units of Fell Bats.

vampiric_powers.name: Supernatural Horror
vampiric_powers.description:
Von Carstein, Necrarch or Strigoi only. The model
gains the Terror special rule.
vampiric_powers.restriction: Von Carstein, Necrarch or Strigoi only.

vampiric_powers.name: Transfix
vampiric_powers.description:
Von Carstein or Lahmian only. At the beginning of the
Close Combat phase, select one model in base contact
with the Vampire. The victim must pass a Leadership
test or get reduced to Weapon Skill 1 for the duration of
this round of Close Combat phase and all attacks
directed against the victim will hit automatically.

vampiric_powers.name: Hunter In The Dark
vampiric_powers.description:
Lahmian or Strigoi on foot only. The model has the
Scouts special rule.
vampiric_powers.restriction: Lahmian or Strigoi on foot only.

vampiric_powers.name: Unbending Willpower
vampiric_powers.description:
Von Carstein or Necrarch only. Units of Undead within
6" of one or more models with this power suffer one
less Wound than they normally would due to the
Unstable special rule or following the death of the
army's General. Note that this is not cumulative with
the Battle Standard.
or your Vampires. You cannot buy multiples of the same
e same army can have the same powers if you wish. Each
e (unless specified).

vampiric_powers.name: Honour Or Death
vampiric_powers.description:
Von Carstein or Blood Dragon only. After issuing or
accepting a challenge with a model with this power, the
enemy character must take a Leadership test. If failed,
the enemy model will automatically refuse the
challenge following the normal rules.
vampiric_powers.restriction: Von Carstein or Blood Dragon only.

vampiric_powers.name: Von Carstein Aura Of Dark Majesty
vampiric_powers.description:
All enemy units within 6" of one or more models with
the Aura of Dark Majesty suffer a -1 penalty to their
Leadership. This penalty is cumulative with any other
modifiers.

vampiric_powers.name: Spectral Attendants
vampiric_powers.description:
All enemy Wizards within 18" of the model must re-
roll successful channelling results.

vampiric_powers.name: Walking Death
vampiric_powers.description:
Any unit in base contact with the model must re-roll
successful Break tests.

vampiric_powers.name: Call Winds
vampiric_powers.description:
Bound Spell (Level 3, cast on 9+). Call Winds is a hex
aura spell with a range of 24". Until the start of caster's
next Magic phase, all enemy missile attacks fired from
within or at a target within range suffer -1 To Hit.

vampiric_powers.name: Earth Bind
vampiric_powers.description:
The model and any unit they join gain the Magic
Resistance (1) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Summon Creatures Of The Night
vampiric_powers.description:
This Vampire can use the Invocation of Nehek spell to
heal and increase units of Dire Wolves, Bat Swarms
and Fell Bats beyond their starting size, even though
they are not all Undead.

vampiric_powers.name: Wolf Form
vampiric_powers.description:
Model on foot only. The model gains Movement 9 and
the Swiftstride special rule. In addition, they may join
units of Dire Wolves.

vampiric_powers.name: Wolf Lord
vampiric_powers.description:
The model allows all friendly units of Dire Wolves
within 24" of it to March.

vampiric_powers.name: Necrarch Wellspring Of Dark Magic
vampiric_powers.description:
The model and all friendly Wizards within 12" gain +1
to cast spells from the Lore of Necromancy.

vampiric_powers.name: Spectral Form
vampiric_powers.description:
Model on foot only. The model gains the Ethereal
special rule. However, it may not join non-Ethereal
units or take any magic items.

vampiric_powers.name: Mastery Over Flesh
vampiric_powers.description:
When casting the Invocation of Nehek, Vanhel's Danse
Macabre, Hellish Vigour or Raise Dead spells from the
Lore of Necromancy, the model may re-roll all the
initial casting dice (unless they have rolled a Miscast).

vampiric_powers.name: Unholy Cynosure
vampiric_powers.description:
Once per Magic phase, the model can re-roll one of the
dice rolled to cast a spell. This can be used to negate a
Miscast result or could cause an Ultimate Power result.

vampiric_powers.name: Forbidden Lore
vampiric_powers.description: The model has the Loremaster special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Dark Acolyte
vampiric_powers.description:
The model adds +1 to the number of Wounds healed
(Core Units regain +D3 Wounds) whenever it
successfully casts Invocation of Nehek.

vampiric_powers.name: Nehekhara'S Noble Blood
vampiric_powers.description:
The model adds +6" to the range of all their spells
(excluding auras).

vampiric_powers.name: Master Of The Black Arts
vampiric_powers.description:
A player using a model with the Master of the Black
Arts power can re-roll the result when it is determining
the strength of the Winds of Magic in each of your
Magic phases.

vampiric_powers.name: Blood Dragon Doomrider
vampiric_powers.description:
Cavalry only. The model and any Cavalry unit it is with
can re-roll failed charge distances.

vampiric_powers.name: Dread Knight
vampiric_powers.description:
While fighting in a challenge, the model will gain +1
To Hit and To Wound.

vampiric_powers.name: Warrior Pride
vampiric_powers.description:
Infantry or Cavalry only. The model can re-roll failed
armour save results of 1.

vampiric_powers.name: Heart Piercing
vampiric_powers.description:
The model can re-roll To Wound rolls of 1 in close
combat.

vampiric_powers.name: Master Strike
vampiric_powers.description: The model has the Killing Blow special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Might Of Arms
vampiric_powers.description: The model can re-roll To Hit rolls of 1 in close combat.

vampiric_powers.name: Strength Of Steel
vampiric_powers.description:
The model has the Devastating Charge and Mighty
Blow (1) special rules.

vampiric_powers.name: Blademaster
vampiric_powers.description:
The model gains the Parry (6+) special rule, even while
mounted.

vampiric_powers.name: Furious Charge
vampiric_powers.description:
In any turn in which the model makes a successful
charge, they have the Ignores Armour saves special
rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Strigoi Massive Monstrosity
vampiric_powers.description:
Model on foot only. The model gains +2 Wounds and
becomes Monstrous Infantry. It should be placed on a
40x40mm base.

vampiric_powers.name: Loathsome Stench
vampiric_powers.description:
All enemy units in base contact with the model suffer
-1 to their Weapon Skill.

vampiric_powers.name: Iron Sinews
vampiric_powers.description: The model may re-roll failed To Wound roll.

vampiric_powers.name: Terrible Blows
vampiric_powers.description:
The model gains the Multiple Wounds (D3) special
rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Ghoulkin
vampiric_powers.description: One unit of Crypt Ghouls may be deployed as Scouts.

vampiric_powers.name: Infinite Hatred
vampiric_powers.description:
The model's Hatred special rule applies in every close
combat round, not just the first.

vampiric_powers.name: Monstrous Mass
vampiric_powers.description:
The model gains the Immunity (Killing Blow, Multiple
Wounds) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Ravenous
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Frenzy special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Summon Ghouls
vampiric_powers.description:
The model allows one unit of Crypt Ghouls to deploy
as Ambushers.

vampiric_powers.name: Lahmian Seduction
vampiric_powers.description:
At the beginning of the Close Combat round, after
challenges have been issued and/or accepted, select a
model in base contact with the Vampire. The selected
model must take a Leadership test with a -1 modifier. If
the test is failed, the victim is controlled by the
Vampire player in that Close Combat phase.
The model will direct its attacks against his own side.
The model cannot be attacked by either side in that
Close Combat phase but, after combat resolution has
been worked out, it reverts immediately to the original
player's control and can therefore use his Leadership
for any Break tests and can be broken and pursued as
normal.
If the model has no friendly models in base contact, it
is unable to attack in that Close Combat phase and all
attacks directed against the victim will hit
automatically.
If the Vampire was in a challenge with a model that it
takes control of, the challenge ends and both models
may attack other targets as normal.

vampiric_powers.name: Lightning Reflexes
vampiric_powers.description:
Enemies must re-roll successful rolls To Hit in close
combat against this model.

vampiric_powers.name: Night Creature
vampiric_powers.description:
Model on foot only. If this model is a lone character, it
cannot be targeted by enemy missile attacks or spells
unless it is within 12".

vampiric_powers.name: Innocence Lost
vampiric_powers.description: The model has the Always Strikes First special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Domination
vampiric_powers.description:
All enemy units in base contact with this model must
re-roll successful Leadership tests (except Break tests).

vampiric_powers.name: Quickblood
vampiric_powers.description: The model gains the Dodge (5+) special rule.

vampiric_powers.name: Beguile
vampiric_powers.description:
At the beginning of the Close Combat round, all units
in base contact with the model must take a Leadership
test with a -3 modifier. If the test is failed, the Vampire
can only be Hit on 6's this turn.

vampiric_powers.name: Swiftness
vampiric_powers.description:
Model on foot only. The model gains Movement 10
and the Swiftstride special rule.
MAGIC ITEMS
This section contains the rules for some of the most iconic
Counts. These may be used in addition to the magic items
